blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) and Canada have concluded their years-long negotiation for a free trade agreement (FTA), Executive Secretary Ralph Recto announced Saturday. Negotiations for the FTA began in 2021 and aimed to boost trade between the 11-member bloc and Canada, which reached $23.4 billion in 2024. “We have concluded the negotiations for the ASEAN-Canada free trade agreement, opening the way to wider markets for our products and services,” Recto said at the ASEAN Business and Investment Summit. “The value of these agreements will be seen in the enterprises that reach new customers, the investments they […]...
